/Memos/Wedy.memo.name: Wedy

author.ask: Remember how Wedy should look in every promo.

/Memos/Wedy.memo.body:
# Wedy

Wedyan's mascot: a small lantern with **round eyes** and a warm amber glow.

- Always friendly, never loud.
- Speaks in short lines.
- Shown on the left of the frame, looking right.

/Memos/Render settings.memo.name: Render settings

author.ask: What did we settle on for exports?

/Memos/Render settings.memo.body: Exports go out as **H.264 MP4**, 1920 × 1080 at 30 fps. Keep the bitrate near 8 Mbps so a 30 second cut stays under 50 MB.

/Memos/Voice-over.memo.name: Voice-over
/Memos/Voice-over.memo.body:
Record the voice-over again once the script is final.

1. Read the hook slower.
2. Drop the second line of the outro.
3. Leave a beat before the name.

/Memos/Music ideas.memo.name: Music ideas
/Memos/Music ideas.memo.body:
Something warm under the intro: a soft piano, or a plucked guitar.

> Keep it quiet enough that the voice-over leads.

/Memos/Reading.memo.name: Reading

/Memos/Mornings.memo.name: Mornings
/Memos/Mornings.memo.body: No meetings or reminders before **10:00**. Mornings are for making things.
